Plaintiff prepared an N.D. Cal. § 1983 complaint (v3, 20 pp., six causes) and a print intake packet under the Ngwa Nforbi name form, demanding compensatory damages >$214,000, then superseded it with a First Amended Complaint (same six causes; 21 pp. as submitted, 22 pp. as corrected).
